issues.description: Method name mismatch for the farm-song routine: the problem statement (UML and Part 3 instructions) refers to a public method named printFarmSong(), while the provided template and the reference solution both declare and use a public method named singFarmSong() in Farm.java. This naming inconsistency between the specification (problem_statement.md) and the code (template/solution) can confuse students about which method to implement or call and may lead to mismatched tests or wasted effort renaming methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the farm-song method name consistent across all artifacts. Option A (preferred): update problem_statement.md (UML and Part 3 instructions) to refer to singFarmSong() so the specification matches the template and solution. Option B: rename the method in the template and solution from singFarmSong() to printFarmSong() and update all call sites (e.g., Main.java) and any tests. Ensure the method remains public void and signatures match across specification, template, solution, and tests.
